d: A peaceful town is rocked by the murder of the young wife of a preacher's son; the investigation leads detectives to two brothers: one with a deadly ambition, and the other willing to do anything to earn his brother's love.

When the body of a young woman is found in a burnt out station wagon, investigators unravel a deadly plot that leads back to a shattered marriage and two self-made millionaire brothers who feel entitled to do anything to anyone.
A double-homicide in a small Ohio town leads police to a family member with a grudge over $400 that leads two brothers to spiral out of control.

After three ruthless murders and a month-long spree of armed robberies, police in Fort Worth, Texas, race to stop a young man intent on inflicting pain, his honor student sibling and a second set of brothers.

A home invasion by masked gunmen leads to the murder of a doctor trying to protect his family, but when investigators track down three brothers, they discover the kidnapping plot gone wrong was masterminded from within the doctor's own circle.

When a wealthy businessman and his wife are brutally gunned down, detectives discover a family torn apart by resentment and greed, and uncover a murder plot between the couple's sons and a second set of brothers hired to pull the trigger.
A rural community in Georgia is rocked by two double-homicides within 24 hours, including a beloved dairy farmer and his son, but a piece of evidence eventually leads detectives to two brothers.

A man's murder outside his home in suburban Memphis leads investigators to multiple extramarital affairs, a wife's secret life, an insurance policy, and a brother willing to do anything for his sister.

Teen brothers rebel against their strict upbringing and become skinheads, and when their mother, father and younger brother are discovered murdered in their home, police begin a manhunt that leads them across three states.
A home invasion starts a massive manhunt through the remote, snowy wilderness of Idaho for two bank-robbing brothers who once helped catch a notorious Soviet spy.
While investigating the murder of a devoutly religious couple, police uncover dark family secrets, leading them to a shocking suspect.
When a popular college student is found slain in the middle of campus, police suspect his friends and lovers might be involved.
When a suburban mom is murdered in her own home, investigators chase down an elusive killer that no one saw coming.
Police in small town Louisiana investigate the mysterious and brutal murder of a beloved neighbor with no known enemies.
After a college student is viciously murdered and her apartment set ablaze, police untangle a web of relationships to find a killer who's dangerously close to home.
A couple and their special needs son are savagely murdered in rural New Mexico, leading detectives to uncover long-buried secrets in a tight-knit town.
A devoted mother about to begin a new life is murdered in her own home; detectives follow the evidence through a tangled web of relationships to unmask the killer.
When a loving father and beloved basketball coach is murdered in Tennessee, police decode a confusing array of evidence to unveil a killer who is shockingly close to home.

When a devoted mother with a bright future in show business is ruthlessly gunned down, a number of suspects emerges; just as detectives think they have the killer in their sights, the investigation takes a jaw-dropping turn.
A wealthy businessman and his closest friend are found shot execution-style; police have little to go on until a surprising development leads investigators to a killer no one ever suspected.
When a brilliant scientist and devoted family man is found beaten to death, the evidence leads to arrests, but an astounding revelation turns the investigation on its head.
